questions.title: How long does it take to build my website?
questions.description: The timeline depends on the scope of your project. On average, a standard showcase website takes between 1 and 2 weeks once all content is gathered. For custom web applications or more complex integrations, timelines are assessed and scheduled right from the initial planning phase.

questions.title: Will I own the website and the domain name?
questions.description: Absolutely! You own 100% of it. Unlike long-term rental or multi-year commitment contracts offered by some agencies, you are the sole owner of your domain name and source code upon final delivery of the project.

questions.title: What do I need to provide to get the project started?
questions.description: To get started, I just need your basic elements: your visuals (logo, photos of completed work/projects), and your contact details. As for the web page copywriting, I partner with Jeff Bond, Senior SEO Copywriter, to ensure high-impact content optimized for search engines.

questions.title: What is your preferred tech stack?
questions.description: I specialize in Full-Stack development. On the Frontend, I primarily work with Vue.js and Nuxt.js to deliver blazing-fast, SEO-optimized interfaces. On the Backend, I rely on Python (FastAPI) and Node.js to build robust, secure APIs.

questions.title: What happens after the website goes live?
questions.description: Once the website is delivered and launched, you retain full autonomy. To ensure your peace of mind, I also offer an ongoing support and maintenance package (Hosting & Visibility): I handle secure hosting, technical updates, Google SEO tracking, and small content updates on demand.
